Bangalore, Karnataka 560011| 9901078108| svikasgowda@gmail.com| LinkedIn: www.linkedin.com/in/vikas-s-6b8266125

Professional SummarySenior Data Scientist with over 8.5 years of experience in building AI systems across NLP, Computer Vision, Generative AI andAutomation of Agentic workflows. Skilled in applying deep learning and large language models to solve complex problems anddeliver scalable solutions. Strong foundation in model development, deployment, and iterative improvement using modernMLOps practices.

SkillsPython Libraries: Scikit-learn, OpenCV, Beautiful Soup,TensorFlow, PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers•LLMs: Azure GPT-4, Google Gemini, Claude, ViT•Machine Learning & AI: NLP, Computer Vision, DeepLearning, Generative AI, Fine Tuning Representation andGeneration Models, Vector Embeddings, PromptEngineering•Frameworks & Tools: Langchain, CrewAI , Autogen,Spacy, Haystack, HuggingFace, MLFlow, AWS and AzureML services•

Work History08/2021 - CurrentSenior Data ScientistIndegene – Bengaluru, India (Remote)AI-Powered Design-to-Code Automation:Impact:Agentic AI for Multimodal PDF-to-HTML Update Automation:Product Overview: Spearheaded data science efforts for an AI product that automates the conversion of PDF-basedemailers and e-detail designs into responsive HTML. This tool eliminates manual HTML development, streamliningworkflows, and improving productivity across design and development teams.•Content Extraction: Utilized Azure Document Intelligence/AWS Textract to accurately extract text, images, and itsmetadata from PDFs, ensuring seamless design-to-code translation.•Custom Object Detection: Designed and deployed YOLO v10 models to identify key layout features, such as CTAs, lines,and other design elements.•Generative AI Implementation: Engineered workflows using LLMs for automated HTML-to-MJML conversion.Integrated advanced features like background gradient detection, CTA shape identification, and vertical text propertyextraction.•Layout Structuring: Built custom algorithms to detect rows and column layouts, providing critical insights to front-endteams for responsive HTML generation.•Achieved a 70% reduction in development time for converting varied PDF complexities into responsive HTML.•Improved content extraction accuracy for production-ready designs. Adopted by 8-10 enterprise clients, each with 5 or moredevelopers, driving significant productivity gains across teams.•Developed an autonomous pipeline using CrewAI and LLMs to process annotated PDFs and update HTML files.•Implemented agentic reasoning to identify annotation intent in PDF(e.g., text edits, image alignments).•Integrated multimodal inputs (OCR, bounding box, HTML/CSS) to support structured transformations.•

ICB (Intelligent Content Brain)Impact:Designed feedback loops for validation and self-correction.•Project Overview: Developed an AI-powered tool that processes PDFs (e.g., emailers, e-details) to extract and analyzecontent intelligently, using advanced vision and NLP techniques. This platform provides intelligent content analysis andactionable insights for end clients.•Key Message Tagging: Fine-tuned a multi-class classification model using BERT to identify and tag critical key messages,enhancing automated content analysis.•Image/Text Semantic Modeling: Implemented transfer learning to build a robust image/text similarity model.•Multilingual NER Model: Utilized SpaCy and Hugging Face frameworks to extract NER in 12+ languages, expanding thetool's global applicability for a diverse clientele.•MLOps Implementation: Designed a comprehensive data science pipeline with data collection, model retraining, andmodel deployment, leveraging AWS and MLFlow for iterative model updates based on feedback loops.•Achieved 70–80% accuracy across domain-specific models with iterative retraining, ensuring reliable content extraction forenterprise clients.•Enabled seamless processing of PDFs on demand, supporting multiple clients under subscription models for PDFprocessing.•10/2019 - 08/2021Data ScientistGenpact – Bengaluru, India (Remote)Binary Classification for Bad Debt Estimation: Developed a binary classification model using ensemble techniques toestimate the probability of customers being a Bad Debt.•Impact: Saved approximately 25% of revenue year over year by proactively managing financial risks.•Time Series Modeling for Pharmaceutical Sales Prediction: Utilized theHolt-Winters model for forecasting units andsales of multiple pharmaceutical brands over 2 years. Improved accuracy by applying better seasonality and trend factors.•Impact: Achieved 10-15% higher accuracycompared to the previous SAS model, improving sales predictions.•12/2016 - 09/2019Data EngineerLTI – Bengaluru, IndiaWorked on Predictive Modellingfor internal stakeholders to estimate SLA for Priority Incidents, Resource Estimation basedon SLA which enabled 20-25%better use of Resource Management.•Led Server Infrastructure Development and Management of Production systems for ETL(informatica)•Involved in Automation process of Admin Console Monitoring which resulted insavings of manual 15% efforts•
